name: research-task-system
description: Current-action TODO research workflows with MATLAB-first computation, source-validated aggregation, fingerprinted YAML state, exact human-approved rule paths, and reproducible researcher-reviewed figures.

interface.longDescription: Author a current-action research TODO, maintain a fingerprinted YAML lifecycle with explicit self-transitions and human-confirmed rule paths, execute MATLAB-first production computation through work/right/fast gates, validate controlling sources and aggregate evidence, govern verified parameter rewrites, and produce clean-kernel researcher-reviewed figures without parallel scientific handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use Research Task System to author current-action-only TODO specifications from this research material.
Use Research Task System to initialize or inspect task state, evaluate all outgoing rules including self, and wait for human confirmation of one rule path.

Use Research Task System to execute the recorded state with MATLAB-first computation and make-it-work, make-it-right, make-it-fast gates, validate aggregate sources and calculations, and keep clean-kernel figure planning, researcher review, and final QA separate.
